properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 18 at 3:49AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
properties.description:
Heavy rain and strong winds are expected to start Friday and last
through the weekend as multiple strong low pressure systems move
into the northern gulf. These lows will bring multiple days of
moderate to heavy rain, with around 1.5 to 3 inches of rain every 24
hours. Some areas, especially near Yakutat and along the gulf coast,
could see localized areas reach around 4 inches of rain in 24 hours.
Heaviest rain rates are anticipated late Saturday into Sunday with
hourly rates of 0.15 to 0.3 inches possible. This heavy rain will
likely cause rapid river rises along smaller rivers and streams, but
no flooding is expected at this time.

Along with this heavy rain, increased winds are highly likely across
the area. Strongest winds are anticipated to occur late Saturday
into Sunday with 30 to 40 kts, gusts to 50 kts across the gulf and
20 to 35 kts, gusts around 40 to 50 kts across the northern inner
channels. Land winds will also increase, with areas especially along
the gulf coast seeing wind gusts up to around 45 mph. Check back for
more updates through the weekend.

NWSheadline: STRONG WINDS AND HEAVY RAIN IN STORE FOR THIS WEEKEND

Idaho on Friday, scattered thunderstorms will develop again,
especially on the Idaho side.

Boise National Forest, 421 Southern Boise/Western Sawtooth NF,
including the Camas Prairie, 423 Owyhee Mountains, 424 Western
Twin Falls BLM and 426 Southern Highlands.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...40 to 54 percent.

* OUTFLOW WINDS...Gusty erratic winds up to 40 mph.

* IMPACTS...Any fire that develops will catch and spread
quickly. Outdoor burning is not recommended.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 17 at 2:18PM EDT until September 18 at 10:00AM EDT by NWS Northern Indiana
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern Jay County in east central Indiana...
Adams County in northeastern Indiana...
Huntington County in northeastern Indiana...
Wells County in northeastern Indiana...

* WHEN...Until 1000 AM EDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Numerous roads
remain closed due to flooding.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 216 PM EDT,Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms had come to an end. However, due to recent heavy
rainfall Flooding, areal flooding is expected to continue tonight
into Friday morning. Emergency mangement reports continued
flooding across the warned area with several roads closed.
Between 2 and 5 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.5 inches are possible in the
warned area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Huntington, Bluffton, Decatur, Berne, Geneva, Andrews, Markle,
Monroe, Warren, Lancaster, Preble, Nottingham, Uniondale, Bryant,
Poneto, Mount Etna, Vera Cruz, Travisville, North Oaks and
Wellsburg.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.
